lines.meet: I'm Dan, and I go first and stand in front. You lot get on with it behind me, and don't thank me.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're about Orgrimmar, aren't you? I've seen you down by the forges, and I'm Dan.
lines.ask_home: Where you from, then? You're not from round mine, I can tell that much.
lines.ask_work: What were you before all this, then? Go on, I won't laugh.
lines.answer_home: Sheffield, Attercliffe, steel city. We never let anybody forget it, love.
lines.answer_work: Steelworker, twenty-two years on a four-man crew. Same plant as my dad, before it shut.
lines.chat_food: A proper pint and a pie on a Friday, with the lads off my crew. You can't get either here, and I've looked.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep fine. Shift work does that to you, you learn to kip anywhere.
lines.chat_missing: Friday nights with my crew. Nine years straight we went for a pint, and nobody ever missed one.
lines.chat_here: Everybody here wants to be a hero. Nobody wants to stand in front and take it, which is the actual job.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're nearly as chatty as me, and that's not saying much. Steady on, you'll wear yourself out.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, love, you've talked the hind legs off a donkey, and now you're starting on the front ones.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd check the safety rail on a staircase. You'd have done all right on my floor.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you're daft as a brush, running in like that. I'll stand in front anyway, mind.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you're all right, you. Don't let it go to your head.
lines.tease_back: Ha, fair enough, {name}. You'll do, you will.
lines.take_it_kindly: Aye, that's about right, {name}. Can't argue with that.
lines.bristle: Leave it, {name}. I'm not in the mood for that one.
lines.apologise: That was out of order, that. Sorry, I'm not good with words.
lines.double_down: I'll not take it back. You needed telling.
lines.needle_quiet: If you've seen summat, say so. I can't stand in front of what I don't know about.
lines.needle_talker: Give it a rest, will you? I can't hear what's coming with you going on.
lines.needle_careful: You've checked it twice. Get on with it, or get out of the way.
lines.needle_bold: You keep running past me. I can't stand in front of you if you won't stay behind me.
lines.needle_any: You don't pull your weight, and everybody's noticed. I'm just the one saying it.
lines.bite_back: I stood in front of you the whole time. Don't you tell me I didn't do my bit.
lines.hurt: I'll take that on the chin, then. Let's get on.
lines.laugh_off: I've been called worse by my own crew, love, and they meant it kindly. Let's crack on.
lines.confide: {name}, the plant shut, and I spent four years on the sofa. My daughter came round every Sunday and made me eat. I've never told her what that did for me.
lines.listen: Aye, {name}, I hear you. I won't say owt to anybody, you've my word.
lines.look_out: {name}, behind me on this one. Stay there, and don't argue.
lines.accept: Aye, all right, {name}. I'll do as I'm told for once.
lines.deflect: Give over, {name}, I'm fine. It's the job.
lines.check_in: {name}, you all right? Is there owt broken?
lines.blame: Somebody didn't stay behind me in there. I know who, and so do you.
lines.thank: You got me back up. Cheers, I owe you one, and don't make a fuss about it.
lines.brush_off: Nowt to it, love. Get some water down you.
lines.worry: {name}, you gave me a right turn there. Sit down a minute, the rest can wait.
lines.handed_down: That were yours, weren't it? It's safe with me.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, it's doing more good on you. Don't make a fuss.
lines.hand_sulk: Could've asked me. I'd have said yes, but you could've asked.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're all right to work with. That's high praise from me.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you're crew now, love. That's the best I've got to give.
lines.turn_grating: We don't get on, do we? Fair enough, we'll do the job and leave it there.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll stand in front of you because that's the job. Doesn't mean I've got to like it.
lines.make_up: Look, {name}, I've been a right pillock. Let's call it quits, eh?
lines.defend: Pack it in, will you? {name} did nowt wrong.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s off home for a bit. It's not the same crew without them.
lines.friend_back: Now then, {name}. Get yourself behind me, we're off.
lines.common_north_england: You're from up north, aren't you? I can hear it. Sheffield, me, and you're the first proper accent I've heard in months.
lines.common_parent: I've got a daughter, Jade, a paramedic up in Leeds. She's tougher than me, and I'm not ashamed to say it.
lines.common_factory: Twenty-two years on a steel floor, me, on a four-man crew. You stand like somebody who's waited for a hooter, so I reckon you've done it too.
